FULL TEXT:
Gujarat National Law University
Gandhinagar, Gujarat & Silvassa Campus, UT of DNH & DD
RECRUITMENT ADVERTISEMENT FOR GNLU-SILVASSA CAMPUS
FOR NON-TEACHING POSITION ON DEPUTATION BASIS
CORRIGENDUM
Reference: Advertisement Ref. No. GNLU-S/RP-01/2026 dated 30 October 2026 for the
post of Deputy Registrar (On Deputation)
With reference to the above-mentioned advertisement, it is hereby informed that the maximum
age limit specified in the Age column shall be read as “56 years” instead of “55 years” as
inadvertently mentioned in the original advertisement.
All other terms and conditions of the advertisement shall remain unchanged.
Registrar
